scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && glib-compile-schemas schemas && cp -r schemas icons metadata.json src/*.js dist && node -e "const f='dist/metadata.json'; const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f)); m._buildTime=new Date().toISOString(); require('fs').writeFileSync(f, JSON.stringify(m, null, 2)+'\n')" && cd dist && zip -r -p volume-mixer *
